purpose: Teach: 短縮/共存/退院/各自/待機/早起き/仲介/専業

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、捜査時間、絶対、短縮、絶対、努めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police are genuinely committed to shortening investigation time. We're truly grateful.
lines.style: Formal, measured delivery. Even cadence. Professional composure. Direct eye contact. Not performative — simply stating institutional commitment with quiet authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察と民間警備、本気で、絶対、共存、絶対、する体制、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The coordination between police and private security is invaluable to us.
lines.style: Warm agreement. Slightly leaning-in tone. Affirming the partnership without overstating. Steady, appreciative pacing. The voice of someone who has seen the system work.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 被害者の、本気で、絶対、退院、絶対、警察、絶対、お見舞い、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We made sure to visit the victim after they were discharged from the hospital.
lines.style: Even-toned procedural statement. Slight emphasis on the care-action itself, not the announcement. Professional but not cold. A small gesture treated straightforwardly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、各自、絶対、担当区、絶対、明確、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Having each officer clearly assigned to their district makes a real difference.
lines.style: Warm, affirming nod in the voice. Tempo slightly unhurried. Recognition of practical detail that shows understanding. Genuine appreciation for clear structure.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 非常時、本気で、絶対、警察、絶対、待機、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: In emergencies, we maintain rigorous police readiness at all times.
lines.style: Calm assertion. Slight weight on 'rigorous.' Unwavering commitment in the tone. Professional, steady, no inflation — stating a fact with understated confidence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、早起き、絶対、朝、絶対、巡回、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The early morning patrols throughout the neighborhood are much appreciated.
lines.style: Warm, genuine acknowledgment. Slight lift of relief in the tone — someone noticing this protection in real life. Appreciative but not effusive.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 示談、本気で、絶対、仲介、絶対、弁護士、絶対、紹介します、本気で、感謝
lines.en: For settlements, we'll help mediate and connect you with a lawyer if needed.
lines.style: Helpful, matter-of-fact offer. Warm but not oversolicitous. Offering practical support with the clarity of someone who has done this well before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、本気で、絶対、専業、絶対、対策班、絶対、組まれて、絶対、ありがたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Having a dedicated task force focused on this is something we're very thankful for.
lines.style: Quiet depth of gratitude. Recognition of sustained effort and resource. Warm but restrained. The appreciation of someone who knows what it took to assemble that team.
